key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, supervisory authority duties, liability of responsible officials
deceased_data: Data of deceased protected only where it could relate to or affect living persons; health data stays confidential after death (Law On the Rights of Patients); no fixed term found
research_exemption: Derogations for scientific/historical research, statistics and public-interest archiving (national documentary heritage): some data subject rights limited (art. 89 GDPR); article number not confirmed
genetic_data: Special category (art. 9 GDPR); Human Genome Research Law requires written consent of gene donors for genetic research and genome database
notes: Replaced the earlier Personal Data Protection Law; 2021 amendment added fines for officials
